payload.title: DIP-L06: Expand explicit discovery adapters beyond native Git execution
payload.description:
Coverage boundary. QA baseline: DIP v0.3.2, 6 October 2026.

Trace2 covers compatible native Git that identifies a worktree. Independent Git libraries, alternate execution hosts/configurations and environment overrides can bypass it. Commands without worktree identity and bare repositories cannot be treated as project discovery signals.

Evidence and starting points: docs/git-discovery.md, docs/compatibility.md.

This is unassigned contributor backlog, not implemented work. Preserve the existing license, DCO and local/offline defaults.
acceptance: Choose and verify at least one additional host/client adapter using real worktree context instead of promising universal Git interception.
Maintain a capability matrix including remote hosts, independent libraries, override conflicts and unsupported/no-worktree cases.
Preserve unrelated Trace2 targets, existing Git hooks and Git stdout/exit codes; no implicit cloud/model call.
Test adoption outside discovery roots and truthful unsupported/disabled diagnostics on the selected adapter.
